body:
WHAT
Read returns a file as numbered lines ('cat -n' style) with a 2000-line window and a note telling the caller which offset to continue from. It requires an absolute path. Directories, missing files and binary files (a NUL byte in the first 8KB) get distinct explanatory errors. Images (png/jpg/gif/webp) are sent to a separate vision model and come back as a text description, or are refused when no vision model is configured. Documents (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/RTF/ODT/EPUB) are text-extracted under a 20MB cap. Every successful read is recorded so Edit/Write can check freshness.

WHY
Without these guards the model would receive mojibake for binaries, confidently describe an image it never saw, or edit a file it never read.

WHERE
engine/tools/src/read.ts — readTool (permissionClass 'read', outputByteLimit 250000), numberLines() (MAX_LINE_LENGTH 2000, continuation notice), IMAGE_TYPES, DOC_EXTS, MAX_DOC_BYTES, MAX_IMAGE_BYTES, execute(): isAbsolute, statSync miss -> 'File does not exist', isDirectory branch, image branch (ctx.session.visionUnavailableReason(), ctx.session.describeImageForContext()), document branch (extractDocumentText from @magentra/core), NUL-byte check, empty-file branch, fileState.recordRead(). Vision hop in engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — visionUnavailableReason()/describeImageForContext().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Write a temp file with 5 lines; Read it and assert lines are formatted as right-padded number + tab + text starting at 1; Read with offset 2, limit 2 returns lines 3-4 and a notice 'call Read with offset=4'; fileState.wasRead(path) becomes true.
2. Read a directory, a missing path and a relative path; assert three different isError messages ('is a directory', 'File does not exist', 'must be absolute').
3. Write a file whose first bytes include 0x00; assert isError:true with 'looks like a binary file' and wasRead stays false; write an empty file and assert content '(the file exists but is empty)'.
4. Create a.png; with a fake session whose visionUnavailableReason() returns 'no vision model' assert isError with 'cannot see it' and describeImageForContext was never called; with visionUnavailableReason undefined and describeImageForContext resolving 'a red square' assert content is exactly that text (never image bytes).
5. Read a small real .docx/.pdf fixture; assert content starts with '[extracted from' followed by numbered lines; a document over 20MB (or a stat stub) returns 'File too large for document extraction'.
